items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And, uh, he went around in Mississippi and, and, you know, Spartan, Louisiana with us from time to time.

ctx.x: And, uh, he went around in Mississippi and, and, you know, Spartan, Louisiana with us from time to time. And he was a fine kid, and he always did the things that he recorded later when he got to be a young man. He played all that stuff when he was a kid. stuff like stuff like
the pearls and the jelly roll blues and the whining boy.
